title: A bounded complex with locally constant finite type cohomology is locally represented by a complex of locally constant finite type sheaves
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a site with final object, a Noetherian ring Lambda and a bounded complex K whose cohomology sheaves are locally constant of finite type, there is a covering over which K is represented by a complex of locally constant sheaves of finite type (statement lines 14246-14256). The proof (proof lines 14258-14313) is an induction on the length of the interval containing the cohomology: it passes to a covering making the top cohomology constant, lifts generators to cohomology classes, and uses the associated distinguished triangle together with the local constancy of the kernel to extend the representing complex by one term. H2: a full induction with four inputs, written out in full.
